name: Jophiel
abilities: Radiance Flash — bursts with holy light, blinds nearby enemies, opens window for bonus backstab damage
passives: Choir Edict: Elyndra gains Choir Resonance when disruptor play places a false timing window that punishes enemy overcommitment on ordered sigil zones. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a radiant hierarchy judgment rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Radiant Hierarchies.
lore: Jophiel, Radiant Presence, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Empyrean. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: feminine indwelling divine presence, holy fire, threshold awe, mercy that burns false order. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses feminine indwelling divine presence, holy fire, threshold awe, mercy that burns false order; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Empyrean canon.
visualDescription: Jophiel manifests as feminine indwelling divine presence, holy fire, threshold awe, mercy that burns false order from Empyrean: beautiful awe-filled feminine face, glowing eyes, delicate nose, compassionate severe mouth; elegant feminine flame-bearing frame, soft curves under glass armor, floating threshold posture; signature silhouette: veil-flame aura, censer chain arc, layered glass robes, luminous feminine outline. Weapon: radiance censer-chain and veil of living flame. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Elyndra — Seraph Edict Lash Sever
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Empyrean source-culture damage at range 3; generate Momentum and a small Choir Resonance gain when used from edict-sung holy geometry or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Choir Seal Technique — Interdiction
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to cuts enemy resources, scrambles intent, and creates a counter-window instead of raw lockout. Builds Choir Resonance only when the Avatar uses edict-sung holy geometry intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Elyndra: Ophanim Throne Judgment Null Mandate
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Choir Resonance to impose a two-round rule from Radiant Hierarchies: cuts enemy resources, scrambles intent, and creates a counter-window instead of raw lockout. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Seraphic Choir Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Choir Resonance, transform nearby terrain into edict-sung holy geometry, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Elyndra Interdictor Seraph Bell-Edict Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through edict-sung holy geometry. Visual: white-gold radiance, many-eye auras, opal glass, bell bronze, wing geometries, scroll seals, ophanim wheels, seraph fire.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Elyndra Opal-Glass Cherubim Aegis
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Radiant Hierarchies source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Elyndra Ophanim Many-Eye Choir Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Choir Resonance and unlocks a mastery branch for Archangel Herald Ascent, Ophanim Wheel Intercept, and Seal the Discord. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: interrupt resources, casts, reactions, and elite mechanics
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Elyndra's Choir Edict: a solo mechanic where Choir Resonance grows through ordered sigil zones, reaction-window mastery, and disruptor decisions that place a false timing window that punishes enemy overcommitment. Payoff: break enemy cadence and steal tempo during reaction prompts. Counterplay: patient enemies, cleanses, and baited reactions waste the setup; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: patient enemies, cleanses, and baited reactions waste the setup
